exact_blockers: No source in the supplied record establishes a government-wide Trump administration ban on Signal, WhatsApp, or other encrypted messaging apps; the frozen record also supplies no source for its claim that the purpose was to monitor internal dissent.

exact_blockers.detail: The frozen record gives no order number, title, text, or citation. The asserted authority to detain indefinitely without judicial review and to reach citizens designated as threats is unsupported.

The Federal Register API returned 58 presidential documents published in April 2025; inspection of the titles found no item matching the alleged detention/habeas order. This title-index search is not proof that unpublished guidance did not exist.
